verdict.rationale: IP India publishes registry-style lists and periodicals on its own site: a Design e-register, TMR Journals, the Part A register of registered GIs, a list of well-known trade marks and an electronic register of patent agents. These are first-party public extracts that partly answer the story, but the evidence consists only of navigation titles and never shows bulk or machine-readable downloads. missing for 10: evidence of bulk or machine-readable formats (CSV/XML/JSON), full-dataset exports rather than per-page listings, documented download endpoints or update cadence, statistical datasets, independent corroboration that no scraping is needed.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
